note: Extension packages are fetched live from the official Termux repository (China-direct mirrors, no pre-bundling). ExtensionManager resolves the dependency closure from each item's "packages" field, then pulls the .deb files from a mirror, verifies them and unpacks/installs them. Version and size are read at runtime from the repository's Packages index.

items.name: Python
items.desc: Python interpreter + pip package manager; run python3 / pip3 to install the pure-Python ecosystem once activated

items.name: OpenJDK 17
items.desc: Java development kit (javac/java/jar); compile and run Java programs and build Gradle projects

items.name: Go
items.desc: Go toolchain (go/gofmt) — a statically typed language with great cross-compile support

items.name: Rust
items.desc: Rust toolchain (rustc/cargo) for systems-level development on mobile

items.name: PHP
items.desc: PHP CLI interpreter (php -S can run a dev server)

items.name: Lua
items.desc: Lightweight scripting interpreter, a natural fit for embedded automation scripts

items.name: Perl
items.desc: Perl interpreter for text processing and glue scripts

items.name: Clang / LLVM
items.desc: C/C++ toolchain (clang/clang++/make); can build native bionic extensions

items.name: Git
items.desc: Full version control (clone/commit/push), a replacement for the stripped-down toybox environment

items.name: Archivers
items.desc: zip / unzip / xz / bzip2 to handle every common archive format

items.name: Android build tools

items.name: ImageMagick
